recovery_v2x.selection: Keep exactly rows whose every independent ordered box is full. Preserve original bytes and order.

row_status_definition: Exclusive: unknown if any unknown or no boxes; else half if any half; else full. Presence counts overlap.

streamed_grid_completion.method: Same linspace grids and inner-half exclusion; smaller grid in cKDTree; larger grid queried in chunks; workers=1.
